content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe provide a convenient, all-in-one solution for selling courses, including payment processing, course hosting, and customer management. However, their utility is severely limited for creators in restricted countries due to geographical constraints. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, empowers creators to build their own platforms using tools like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase. This approach allows for complete control over data and payment processing, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude users from countries with high fraud rates or regulatory concerns, leaving many creators in the dark. PayPal account suspensions can result in funds being held for up to 180 days without recourse. This creates an unsustainable environment for digital creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, offers a permanent solution that is accessible regardless of geographic restrictions. By using tools like NOWPayments that support multiple cryptocurrencies, creators can avoid traditional banking issues entirely.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speeds can vary significantly between traditional platforms and sovereign solutions. Stripe and PayPal typically take 2-7 days to process payments, with fees that can add up quickly. In stark contrast, NOWPayments processes transactions almost instantly with a mere 0.5% fee, leveraging blockchain technology for efficient payments. This means that creators using sovereign infrastructure can expect faster access to their funds without the hidden costs associated with traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership of your digital assets.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the fundamental issues with platforms like Teachable and Gumroad is the lack of true ownership over your data and content. Once a creator uploads their material, they are subject to the platform's rules and may lose access at any time. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their products and customer data. With automated delivery systems using tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, creators can ensure their products reach customers immediately after payment is confirmed, without third-party interference.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For those struggling with platform restrictions, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a compelling choice. Deployed in just 48 hours, this stack provides the necessary tools for creators to establish a fully functional digital storefront. With custom configurations for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, end-to-end testing, and 30 days of support, this option ensures that creators can hit the ground running without the typical hassles associated with conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid the pitfalls of suspended accounts and held funds with alternative payment solutions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
